baselineDisplay.title: Tired and Thirsty
baselineDisplay.question: Why do the children thank their mother?
baselineDisplay.questionZh: 为什么孩子们要感谢他们的母亲呢？
baselineDisplay.text:
Why do the children thank their mother?

What's the matter children?
We're tired...
... and thirsty Mum.
Sit down here.
Are you all right now?
No we aren't.
Look!
There's an ice cream man.
Two ice creams, please.
Here you are children.
Thanks Mum.
These ice creams are nice.
Are you all right now?
Yes we are thank you!
baselineDisplay.bodyText:
What's the matter children?
We're tired ...
... and thirsty  Mum.
Sit down here.
Are you all right now?
No we aren't.
Look!
There's an ice cream man.
Two ice creams, please.
Here you are children.
Thanks Mum.
These ice creams are nice.
Are you all right now?
Yes we are thank you!
baselineDisplay.bodyTextZh:
孩子们，怎么了？
我们累了……
……而且渴了，妈妈。
请坐在这里。
现在好点了吗？
不，不好。
看！
有一个卖冰淇淋的叔叔。
请来两份冰淇淋。
孩子们，给你们。
谢谢妈妈。
这些冰淇淋很好吃。
现在好点了吗？
是的，我们很好，谢谢！
